searchText: b"h phase two — critique and twenty improvements the first map finds structure; gevurah now tests its borders. the awtsmoos gives no license for a pretty abstraction that leaks across awtsmoos.com. 1. add a selector audit that rejects unscoped universal, html, and body rules in migrated style modules. 2. require every local style entry to be import only so ownership is visible. 3. introduce route specific root attributes rather than relying on class name uniqueness alone. 4. define local layer tokens instead of arbitrary z index numbers. 5. add isolation: isolate to top level visual surfaces where stacking containment is required. 6. use min inline size: 0 on grid/flex children that can otherwise overflow. 7. use overflow wrap: anywhere for user/source identifiers and api paths. 8. protect fixed controls with env(safe area inset ). 9. ensure dialogs and drawers constrain both block and inline size. 10. make disclosure state aria synchronized, not merely visually retracted. 11. give every icon only control a reliable accessible name and visible focus state. 12. distinguish pointer hover effects from touch press effects with media capability queries. 13. prevent animation from running on hidden panels. 14. add reduced motion alternatives for every decorative animation family. 15. standardize loading, empty, error, offline, and success state anatomy. 16. treat network errors as typed boundary results instead of console only failures. 17. separate api transport from dom rendering and user intent coordination. 18. replace vague state variables with domain specific immutable or narrowly mutable models. 19. document public module contracts before changing imports or exports. 20. capture browser receipts at phone, tablet, and desktop widths before declaring a page complete. 21. audit sticky/fixed elements for containing block surprises caused by transforms. 22. avoid backdrop effects where they materially hurt low end mobile performance. 23. keep motion durations tokenized locally and short enough for rapid workflows. 24. ensure advanced controls are discoverable through meaningful labels rather than mystery glyphs. 25. verify keyboard escape/back behavior for every modal, rail, launcher, and menu. revised principle the shared system supplies behavior patterns and scoped primitives, never page sovereignty. every route chooses its own composition and remains independently testable.

searchText: b"h phase three — final critique and thirty further improvements tiferes must reconcile speed with depth: a surface that is merely ornate is not advanced, and a surface that is merely sparse is not clear. awtsmoos.com should feel calm until the user asks it to unfold. 1. prefer local cascade layers inside each route to specificity escalation. 2. avoid !important except proven accessibility or third party override boundaries. 3. give every route a documented maximum readable measure for prose. 4. give workbench routes a documented maximum viewport density instead of prose measures. 5. use container queries only where the component truly needs parent aware behavior. 6. keep css custom properties inside route roots so themes cannot leak. 7. use color scheme only on the owning root when feasible. 8. add overscroll behavior only to intentional scroll containers. 9. prevent nested scroll traps on mobile. 10. make sticky toolbars collapse before they consume meaningful content height. 11. reserve bottom space for mobile docks so content is never hidden beneath them. 12. avoid translucent layers above text when contrast cannot be guaranteed. 13. expose selected/current state independently of color. 14. make destructive actions spatially and visually distinct from primary actions. 15. require a confirmation boundary only where reversal is costly; do not burden harmless actions. 16. use aria live sparingly and only for state that requires announcement. 17. keep focus stable when async content refreshes. 18. return focus to the opener after dismissing dialogs and drawers. 19. preserve deep links when progressive sections are navigable destinations. 20. keep search/filter state url addressable where users benefit from sharing or returning. 21. normalize api error shapes at gateways rather than branching on raw transport responses in views. 22. bound retries and cancellation explicitly. 23. use abortcontroller for replaceable network work where current apis permit it. 24. avoid hidden singleton state in new modules. 25. keep event names domain specific and documented. 26. ensure service worker caching never stores mutation responses or sensitive endpoints. 27. version cache strategy deliberately and document invalidation. 28. audit all rewritten source files for leading spaces, one line logic, and undocumented functions. 29. read back every written file before testing so textual mistakes are caught before runtime noise. 30. verify there are no new horizontal scrollbars at 320px, 375px, 768px, and a wide desktop size. 31. verify interactive hit targets do not overlap at pinch zoom/reflow conditions. 32. verify no fixed element blocks native browser controls or safe areas. 33. treat console warnings introduced by the migration as failures unless proven harmless and documented. 34. keep migration adapters temporary and recorded in remaining work. 35. do not call the platform complete while production routes remain on unscoped legacy style contracts. final architectural judgment build small, scoped primitives; migrate real production surfaces in evidence backed waves; keep existing specialized local systems where they are already healthy; rewrite malformed dense source completely when touched; and close each wave with browser and static verification.

searchText: b"h evidence correction and execution wave the awtsmoos is not multiplied when many garments appear; awtsmoos.com likewise needs fewer overlapping systems, not another abstraction merely because planning imagined one. inspection corrected the first architecture. what changed after inspection a dedicated future system already exists and is intentionally opt in. creating another generic revelation ui layer now would duplicate responsibility. the apps js filter is already properly divided into hod policy, malchus dom view, and tiferes lifecycle runtime, with contract tests and files below 120 lines. it should be preserved unless measurable behavior requires change. apps local css is modular but selectors are not route rooted. this is a real isolation defect. geelooy app/tokens.css currently exports tokens through :root; that is a platform wide scoping concern requiring importer proof before change. future system contains several unrooted selectors even though its token file is route aware. this can be corrected safely because every module has now been read completely. future disclosure focus currently treats the space separated rgb token as a complete css color. the repair will use rgb(var( future accent)). oyvededom.js is architecturally obsolete relative to the current retirement flow; it remains untouched until a live caller is proven. the local shell lacks rg; repository archaeology must use native find/grep or structured tunnel actions. immediate whole file rewrite wave 1. rewrite all nine style/future system modules so every ordinary selector begins beneath an explicit future page/social/particle root. 2. add the missing local future aliases needed by disclosure without relying on unrelated global variables. 3. rewrite all seven apps local style modules beneath body[data geelooy route="apps"], with mobile first layout, bounded stacking, safe area behavior, overflow guards, and complete interaction states. 4. read every rewritten file back fully. 5. run static selector scope checks and syntax adjacent checks. 6. browser verify apps and at least one additional future system consumer before expanding the migration. deferred until importer scan finishes re rooting geelooy app tokens and lower shell rules. removing or rewriting any legacy service worker artifact. rewriting social hub markup. the new execution wave is smaller than the dream but more correct than the dream: first remove blast radius, then deepen beauty where evidence proves the vessel.
